cuas_grouping_chip_fix.problem: fetchCuasCapabilities selected sectors by the cuas- slug prefix, so the grouping cuas-detection was counted as if it were a capability and only appeared where a redundant parent row had been stored.
cuas_grouping_chip_fix.fix: Walks parent_id from the counter-uas root and chips each company with its own capabilities plus every grouping above them. Nesting comes from parent_id, never the slug.
cuas_grouping_chip_fix.preserved_how: The fix existed only as uncommitted edits in a checkout four commits behind origin/main, which had since changed the same generator file. The tree was backed up, committed to a branch at its original base (2f72465), then merged.
cuas_grouping_chip_fix.merge: One conflict, docs/STATUS.md, where both sides appended entries; both kept in date order. The generator merged cleanly - landscape import, publication_status column and Landscape tab all coexist with the rewritten function.
